prior_diagnostics: v1.0.0: the alternate unit generated a default 0–36 mission because it lacked an explicit Operations profile; transfer could not occur

v1.0.1: an explicit zero-quantity alternate profile fixed that setup, but ENALU=Y and ENALU=N produced byte-identical event logs despite exact input roundtrip; the documented switch did not isolate transfer in this tested model
business_delta: From accepted A17, retain two explicit units at BASE-01 and BASE-02 but remove the group. Schedule one two-aircraft BASIC-MISSION at ordinary TEACH-UNIT with one deployed aircraft. Deploy two at TEACH-UNIT-2; give that unit an explicit ALT-IDLE IQTY=0 Operations profile to prevent a generated default mission. Set Control.ENALU=Y in both variants. The configured variant adds exactly one AlternateUnit row TEACH-UNIT to TEACH-UNIT-2 with PRI=1; the absent control omits the table. Both inputs otherwise differ only in description.
hand_timeline_hypothesis: In the configured variant, the hour-7 call at ordinary TEACH-UNIT initially allocates its one aircraft, then moves the whole mission to ready TEACH-UNIT-2, releases the ordinary aircraft, allocates the two alternate aircraft, starts at hour 8 and succeeds at hour 10. With no AlternateUnit row, the original unit remains one aircraft short, waits and cancels at hour 8.3333. ALT-IDLE creates no mission in either variant.
pre_run_metric_hypothesis: Configured gives one started/successful fixed wave, two sorties, four aircraft-hours and MSTF=MSUF=MTMF=STMF=1. Absent gives no launch, zero operating aircraft-hours and zero fixed start/success factors. Both end with three ready aircraft and no failures, repairs or stock demand.
acceptance_requires: accepted A17 parent, installed source hashes, deterministic builder and exact parent/control deltas
fresh paired five-step session-0 SSH native runs under host mutex and GUI PID13340 guard
exact 14/13 populated business-table import/export roundtrips and zero conversion errors

configured native event log explicitly shows original aircraft released, whole mission moved to TEACH-UNIT-2, its two aircraft launched and mission succeeded; absent control has no move, launch or success
no unintended default mission, reconciled System/Stock interval ledgers, absence of faults and three terminal-ready aircraft in both variants
sealed raw SHA-256 artifacts and separate independent read-only replay
diagnostic_rule: If the absent control transfers or launches, a default mission appears, the configured run lacks explicit release and transfer, or ledgers do not reconcile, keep immutable runs as diagnostics and do not publish this claim.
limitations: One seed, one scheduled fixed demand, one alternate unit and no failures or resource contention.
Multiple-alternate priority ordering, delayed alternate readiness, reassignment after call, preparation failures and explicit formations remain unverified.
ENALU=N did not suppress transfer in the v1.0.1 pair; broader ENALU semantics, GUI and cross-engine behavior remain unverified.
